# QuantPlatform

AI-powered quantitative finance platform. Walk-forward validated ML signals for stocks and crypto. Built with FastAPI, Next.js 14, XGBoost, PostgreSQL, Redis, and GARCH/HMM modeling.

---

## ⚠️ Disclaimer
**Signals generated by QuantPlatform are probabilistic research tools and do NOT constitute financial or investment advice.**
Past backtest performance and walk-forward metrics do not predict or guarantee future market returns. Real money trading involves significant financial risk of loss. Always exercise independent risk management and consult a licensed financial advisor.

## System Architecture

```text
                                +---------------------------+
                                | Browser / Mobile Client   |
                                +-------------+-------------+
                                              |
                                      HTTPS / WSS
                                              |
                                +-------------v-------------+
                                |  Nginx Reverse Proxy / TLS |
                                +-------------+-------------+
                                              |
                                      FastAPI Backend
                                +-------------v-------------+
                                |      FastAPI Server       |
                                |  - REST API (Auth, Market)|
                                |  - WebSockets (/prices)   |
                                |  - Risk & Kelly Sizing    |
                                +-------+-------------+-----+
                                        |             |
                         +--------------+             +--------------+
                         |                                           |
                +--------v--------+                         +--------v--------+
                | PostgreSQL DB   |                         | Redis Cache     |
                | - Users & Auth  |                         | - OHLCV Bars    |
                | - Signals       |                         | - Revoked Tokens|
                | - Positions     |                         | - Rate Limits   |
                +-----------------+                         +-----------------+
                                              |
                                +-------------v-------------+
                                | Data Collectors / ML Core |
                                | - yfinance / Binance      |
                                | - XGBoost & Stacker       |
                                | - GARCH Volatility        |
                                | - HMM Regime Detection    |
                                +---------------------------+
```

## Quickstart (5 Commands)

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository and install dependencies
poetry install

# 2. Set up environment configuration
cp .env.example .env

# 3. Apply database migrations
poetry run alembic upgrade head

# 4. Seed database assets (AAPL, MSFT, BTC-USD, etc.)
poetry run python scripts/seed_assets.py

# 5. Start the backend API server
poetry run uvicorn backend.main:app --reload
```

---

## Environment Variables Reference

| Variable | Type | Default | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `APP_NAME` | string | `QuantPlatform` | System name displayed in logs & docs |
| `DEBUG` | boolean | `true` | Enables debug mode, auto-reload, and interactive docs |
| `SECRET_KEY` | string | *Required* | Secret key for JWT signing (must be ≥32 characters) |
| `ALGORITHM` | string | `HS256` | JWT signing algorithm |
| `ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES` | integer | `30` | Access token lifespan in minutes |
| `REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE_DAYS` | integer | `7` | Refresh token lifespan in days |
| `POSTGRES_SERVER` | string | `localhost` | PostgreSQL database host |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | integer | `5432` | PostgreSQL database port |
| `POSTGRES_USER` | string | `postgres` | Database username |
| `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` | string | `postgres` | Database user password |
| `POSTGRES_DB` | string | `quantplatform` | Target database name |
| `REDIS_HOST` | string | `localhost` | Redis server hostname |
| `REDIS_PORT` | integer | `6379` | Redis server port |
| `ALPHA_VANTAGE_API_KEY` | string | `demo` | Optional API key for fundamental data collector |
| `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | list | `["http://localhost:3000"]` | CORS allowed origins |

## Running Tests

QuantPlatform includes an isolated suite of 50+ unit and integration tests covering API endpoints, authentication flows, walk-forward validation, risk management calculations, and external collectors.

```bash
# Run all tests with coverage report
poetry run pytest tests/ --cov=backend --cov=ml -q

# Run specific test modules
poetry run pytest tests/test_auth.py -v
poetry run pytest tests/test_risk_engine.py -v
poetry run pytest tests/test_walk_forward.py -v
```

---

## Training Your First Model

Train an XGBoost directional classifier with walk-forward out-of-sample validation:

```bash
# Basic model training for a specific ticker
poetry run python scripts/train_model.py --symbol AAPL --interval 1d --years 5

# Enable Optuna hyperparameter search prior to final model fitting
poetry run python scripts/train_model.py --symbol BTC-USD --interval 1d --years 5 --tune
```

---

## Honest AUC Expectations

In financial time-series prediction, realistic out-of-sample performance bounds must be enforced to prevent overfitting and false confidence:

| Out-of-Sample AUC | Evaluation | Deployment Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `< 0.52` | Noise / Pure Chance | **Do NOT deploy.** Reject model artifact. |
| `0.52 - 0.53` | Marginally Predictive | Review feature importances; retain in staging. |
| `0.53 - 0.58` | **Solid Predictive Edge** | **Deployable.** Standard production threshold achieved. |
| `0.58 - 0.65` | Excellent Quant Edge | **Deployable.** High-capacity signal. |
| `> 0.70` | Suspicious / High Risk | **Flagged.** Check immediately for lookahead bias or data leak. |

## Project Structure

```text
Quant_Flow/
├── alembic/                      # Database migrations & version history
│   └── versions/                 # Individual SQL schema migration scripts
├── apps/                         # Client applications
│   ├── mobile/                   # React Native / Expo mobile application
│   └── web/                      # Next.js 14 Web Dashboard
├── backend/                      # FastAPI core backend service
│   ├── api/                      # REST routers and WebSocket handlers
│   │   └── routers/              # Endpoints: auth, market, analysis, portfolio, ws
│   ├── core/                     # Configuration, database setup, and rate limiting
│   ├── middleware/               # CSRF, performance budget, timing middlewares
│   ├── models/                   # SQLAlchemy ORM schemas (User, Asset, Signal, Position)
│   ├── monitoring/               # Prometheus metrics and drift monitoring service
│   └── services/                 # Risk engine, market data service, auth service
├── data_pipeline/                # Data collectors & validators
│   ├── collectors/               # Base, yfinance, Binance, and Alpha Vantage collectors
│   └── validators/               # OHLCV dataset integrity and validation logic
├── deployment/                   # Production deployment configurations
│   ├── postgres/                 # SQL initialization scripts
│   └── scripts/                  # Backup and TLS setup shell scripts
├── ml/                           # Machine Learning & Quantitative Research Engine
│   ├── backtesting/              # Walk-forward splitter and execution simulator
│   ├── features/                 # Technical indicators, GARCH & HMM feature matrix builders
│   ├── models/                   # XGBoost, GARCH, HMM, and Stacker ensemble models
│   ├── risk/                     # Monte Carlo simulation and VaR risk metrics
│   └── artifacts/                # Trained model binaries and JSON metadata
├── scripts/                      # Operational utilities and retraining tools
└── tests/                        # Isolated pytest suite with synthetic fixtures
```

## API Endpoints Reference

### Authentication
- `POST /api/v1/auth/register` — Register a new user account.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/login` — Authenticate user and receive JWT access token and refresh cookie.
- `POST /api/v1/auth/refresh` — Rotate access token using valid httpOnly refresh cookie.
- `DELETE /api/v1/auth/logout` — Revoke active token and clear refresh cookie.
- `GET /api/v1/auth/me` — Fetch authenticated user profile and current capital allocation.

### Market Data
- `GET /api/v1/market/ohlcv` — Query cached historical OHLCV bars for any valid asset.
- `GET /api/v1/market/search` — Search seeded assets by ticker or company name.
- `GET /api/v1/market/health/data` — Retrieve data pipeline and cache health status.

### Analysis & Trading Signals
- `POST /api/v1/analysis/analyze` — Generate ML directional signals and Kelly position sizing.
- `POST /api/v1/analysis/backtest` — Run walk-forward backtest simulation for a ticker.

### Portfolio & Paper Trading
- `POST /api/v1/portfolio/positions/open` — Execute paper trade entry and deduct user cash.
- `POST /api/v1/portfolio/positions/{id}/close` — Close position, compute P&L, and update user cash balance.
- `GET /api/v1/portfolio/positions` — List active open positions with live market P&L.
- `GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary` — Retrieve portfolio total asset valuation and cash balance.

### Monitoring & Real-Time Streams
- `GET /metrics` — Prometheus operational metrics endpoint.
- `GET /api/v1/monitoring/drift` — Check feature drift alerts (KS-test / PSI).
- `WSS /ws/prices?token=...` — Authenticated real-time WebSocket market price stream.

## Contributing

1. Fork the repository and create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`).
2. Run pytest suite (`poetry run pytest tests/ -v`) to verify all tests pass.
3. Ensure no lookahead bias is introduced in feature calculations.
4. Commit changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`).
5. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`).
6. Open a Pull Request.

## Production Data Backfill

To backfill historical price data for the seeded symbols in the production database, run the backfill script directly with the production PostgreSQL credentials:

```bash
POSTGRES_SERVER="your-production-db-host.com" \
POSTGRES_USER="your-db-user" \
POSTGRES_PASSWORD="your-db-password" \
POSTGRES_DB="quantplatform" \
POSTGRES_PORT=5432 \
poetry run python scripts/backfill_ohlcv.py --symbols AAPL,MSFT,NVDA,TSLA,AMZN,GOOGL,META,SPY,QQQ,BTC-USD,ETH-USD --years 5 --interval 1d
```
